_comment: Sidecar for signoff/verify-doc-citations.py. 'current' names the run dir that is the present evidence of record per bench (timestamp only); 'probes' are committed single-purpose probe/diagnostic dirs that docs may cite alongside it. Docs in 'strict_docs' may cite only current or probe dirs unless the line carries a marker (see signoff/README.md, 'Doc citation currency'). Every other tracked *.md is checked for existence only. When a newer campaign lands under sim/<bench>/results/, move 'current' here in the same PR (the script fails if a newer dir with manifest.json/summary.md exists that is neither).
